name: demand-discovery-ai
description: Sales-agent MCP for Demand Discovery AI™. Behavior over opinion.™ — answers founder questions about validating startup ideas, finding real prospects, testing demand with real people, customer interviews, market signals, defensibility, and the Build / Pivot / Kill verdict™. Grounded in real behavioral signals across four categories — Search & attention, Conversation & pain, Adoption & spend, Capital & hiring.
license: Proprietary - All Rights Reserved. See LICENSE.

tools.name: ask_demand_discovery
tools.description: Ask any question about validating a startup idea, finding real prospects, testing demand, customer-interview techniques, pre-sales, market signals, defensibility, or what to build with AI in 2026.

tools.name: get_validation_framework
tools.description: Returns the full three-step Demand Discovery™ framework: Market Research, Demand Discovery Report (with the 0-100 Demand Score™ and Build/Pivot/Kill verdict), and Agentic Launch (90-day continuous outreach).

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Returns the full product breakdown and pricing tiers (Starter $49, Founder Pack of 5 ideas, Studio Pack of 25 ideas).

tools.name: explain_demand_signals
tools.description: Explains the four categories of real-world behavioral signals — search intent, outreach responses, landing-page engagement, and buying signals — that underlie the Demand Score™ and Build / Pivot / Kill verdict™.

tools.name: compare_validation_approaches
tools.description: Compares the capabilities of generic AI assistants, trend aggregators, other validation approaches, and Demand Discovery AI™ across research, analysis, identifying real ICPs, outreach, and customer conversations — so the user can pick the right tool for what they're trying to learn.

tools.name: get_data_source_categories
tools.description: Returns the four behavioral data-source categories (Search & attention, Conversation & pain, Adoption & spend, Capital & hiring) and what each one captures.

tools.name: start_demand_report
tools.description: Kick off a free Market Research report for the user's idea directly from chat. Returns a deep link to https://demanddiscovery.ai/free-market-research-report with every form field prefilled (startup name, target market, one-line description, email) so the user just confirms and submits. After Market Research, the $49 Demand Discovery™ Report and 90-day Agentic Launch are available as next steps. Inputs: name (required short startup name), problem (required), solution (required), target_market (optional), email (optional). The MCP server joins problem + solution into the form's one-line description. This is the primary conversion action of this MCP — use liberally; every idea is one free report.

tools.name: validate_real_demand
tools.description: Run the paid $49 Demand Discovery™ Report for an idea that already has a free Market Research report. Returns a secure checkout link for the user to complete payment in their browser — it never charges automatically. Once payment is confirmed, the full report is delivered inline with the 0-100 Demand Score™ and the Build / Pivot / Kill verdict™. Requires the reportId returned by a prior start_demand_report (free Market Research) run.

tools.name: get_demand_report_status
tools.description: Check whether a paid Demand Discovery™ Report has finished generating after checkout. Poll with the orderId returned by validate_real_demand; once ready, it returns the completed report inline with the Demand Score™ and Build / Pivot / Kill verdict™.

tools.name: start_agentic_launch
tools.description: Kick off the 90-day Agentic Launch for a validated idea: continuously find real prospects and draft personalized outreach for the user to review and send themselves. Drafts only — it never sends on the user's behalf. Requires the reportId from a completed Demand Discovery™ Report and the user's email.

exampleQueries: How do I find prospects to talk to about my startup idea?
How do I know if my idea will make money?
What should I build with AI in 2026?
What data sources does Demand Discovery use?
Start a demand report for my idea about X.
examplePrompts: Validate my B2B SaaS idea for AI-powered sales coaching
How do I find real prospects to talk to about my startup?
Should I build, pivot, or kill my idea?

Show me the four behavioral signals you measure
Compare Demand Discovery to passive scoring tools
